en: Vintage multi‑view chromolithographic postcard with German captions, titled "Gruss aus Hermannstadt." It shows the Großer Ring (Grand Square), the Evangelical Lutheran Cathedral, a theater with fortification towers, and a city panorama. The reverse reads "Correspondenz‑Karte" and bears a green Austro‑Hungarian stamp, addressed in German to Fräulein Marie Wegenstein in Temesvár (Piaristenstrasse).
